strategies.name: Baseline Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling and uncoupling transformations, exactly as in the reference implementation. Each stage executes one all-reduce dispatch followed by local element-wise operations on the full (W*S) tensor. Total 8 all-reduce dispatches with no fusion; represents the straightforward reference approach trading simplicity for maximum dispatch count.

strategies.name: Fused Bidiagonal Transformations Pre-Communication
strategies.desc: Precompute and fuse multiple bidiagonal coupling/uncoupling operations locally before each all-reduce, reducing the number of intermediate all-reduce calls by combining algebraically equivalent transformation sequences. Analyzes the coupling-uncouple-recouple pattern to cancel redundant operations across stages 2-8, potentially reducing to 4-5 all-reduce dispatches. Trades local compute complexity for fewer network synchronization points.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather phases, allowing bidiagonal coupling to be interleaved with the gather phase where each rank already holds partial results. After reduce-scatter, apply local coupling transformations only on relevant shards, then all-gather the coupled results. Maintains 16 total collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but enables better compute-communication overlap and smaller per-operation payloads (W*S/W during scatter).

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Node-Aware Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploits the multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions first (assuming multiple ranks per node), applying bidiagonal transformations at node granularity, then inter-node reductions. Uses node-local all-reduce for faster convergence on shared memory, followed by cross-node all-reduce on aggregated results. Total dispatch count depends on node configuration but typically 16-24 (2-3x per stage for two-level hierarchy); trades dispatch count for better bandwidth utilization on hierarchical interconnect.

strategies.name: Pipelined Bucket-Partitioned All-Reduce Waves
strategies.desc:
Partitions the (W*S) tensor into independent buckets and pipelines their all-reduce operations across the 8 stages, launching the next bucket's stage-k reduction before the previous bucket's stage-(k+1) begins. Each bucket can have its bidiagonal transformation applied asynchronously while other buckets are in-flight. Maintains 8 logical stages but increases total dispatches to 8*num_buckets; trades increased dispatch overhead for latency hiding through pipelining and potential for async execution.
